findings.description: AWS access key and secret access key are embedded in plaintext in the EC2 user_data script, exposing long-lived IAM credentials to anyone with access to the instance metadata, console, or Terraform state.
Ingress rule allows SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the management port of the instance to the entire internet.
Ingress rule allows HTTP (port 80) from 0.0.0.0/0 with no compensating controls (e.g., no TLS), exposing a plaintext web service to the entire internet.
map_public_ip_on_launch is enabled, automatically assigning public IPs to instances launched in this subnet and increasing internet-facing attack surface.
map_public_ip_on_launch is enabled, automatically assigning public IPs to instances launched in this subnet and increasing internet-facing attack surface.
The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true, so the underlying block storage data is stored unencrypted at rest.
The S3 bucket used to store VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration (aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration), leaving sensitive network traffic logs unencrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: missing access controls / public access block
findings.description: No public access block or bucket policy is defined restricting access to the bucket, and force_destroy is enabled, which together with the absence of access controls risks unauthorized exposure of network flow log data.
